title: Melodie Totem
description: Makes Totem of Undying look like Melodie
body:
**Custom totem resource pack that brings Melodie to Minecraft using Totem of Undying.            Totem has its own texture AND it own sound to make it interesting. Hope you will enyoy. No extra mods or texture pack are required.**
